{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

# Print number of unique patients and number of patients with duplicates
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patients: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Number of patients with duplicate rows: {len(duplicate_patients)}")
print(f"Duplicate patient IDs: {duplicate_patients.index.tolist()}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
count_neg999 = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {count_neg999}")"}
